vendors.name: MDL Foods
vendors.category: Local Dishes, Jollof Rice, Waakye, Fufu & Soup, Banku & Tilapia, Kenkey & Fish, Yam Chips
vendors.description: Home-style Takoradi favourites — fragrant Jollof, spicy Waakye, fufu & soup and thick Kenkey platters, prepped fresh and served by our express rider fleet.
vendors.about: MDL Foods is a locally owned kitchen in Takoradi cooking real Ghanaian classics. Everything is made to order with market-fresh produce and delivered hot by a verified dispatch rider.

products.title: Ghana Jollof with Grilled Chicken
products.description: Smoky party jollof, fried plantain and a char-grilled chicken quarter with shito.

products.title: Waakye with Gari & Fish Stew
products.description: Waakye rice and beans served with gari, fried fish stew, boiled egg and shito.

products.title: Fufu with Groundnut Soup
products.description: Fresh pounded fufu, silky groundnut soup and tender stewed beef and chicken.

products.title: Banku & Grilled Tilapia
products.description: Smooth banku, flame-grilled tilapia and pepper sauce with fresh garden eggs.

products.title: Kenkey with Fried Fish & Fried Pepper
products.description: Soft white kenkey, crisp fried fish, fried pepper sauce and sliced onions.
products.shortDescription: Kenkey with Fried Fish & Fried Pepper

products.title: Yam Chips with Khebab
products.description: Golden fried yam chips piled with peppery khebab and spicy sauce.

products.title: Light Soup & Fufu
products.description: Garden-egg light soup with smoked fish, served with soft pounded fufu.

products.title: Special Party Rice & Chicken
products.description: Chef’s party special — coconut-washed rice, stewed chicken and cabbage salad.
